name: xhs-content-studio
description: Xiaohongshu (RED) content ops ENGINE: state/engine/accounts separation, 7 hard gates (incl. G-F cross-note de-dup and G-H content tension), timestamped rerunnable demand mining, persona-fact-checked notes, verified layout rendering.

displayDescription.en: State/engine/accounts-separated XHS engine: rerunnable demand mining, persona fact-check, verified layout. Reads state/ first, never bound to a dead direction.
displayDescription.zh: 小红书内容运营引擎：state/engine/accounts 三层分离、7 个硬 Gate（含跨篇去雷同与内容张力）、可重跑带时间戳需求挖掘、人设事实核查、verified 排版出图。每次先读 state/，不绑死方向。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据当前账号方向，先读 state/ 再决定挖什么需求、写什么笔记（必须先过人设事实核查）
defaultInitPrompt.en: Read state/ first, then decide what to mine and write based on the current account direction (persona fact-check required)

quickPrompts.en: Mine Xiaohongshu demand for the current direction, output a timestamped report into state/demands/
quickPrompts.zh: 按当前方向挖一波小红书需求，产出带时间戳的需求报告存到 state/demands/

quickPrompts.en: Write a set of note plans that pass persona fact-check (attach the fact list)
quickPrompts.zh: 给我写一组笔记方案，必须先过人设事实核查（附事实清单）

quickPrompts.en: Render this note into publishable images using verified layout tools
quickPrompts.zh: 用 verified 排版工具把这篇笔记排成可发布的图
